generationInputs.prompt: A digital rendering with a predominantly dark background showcases a golden, reflective lion sculpture undergoing disintegration, a fair-skinned young adult male figure with curly blonde hair in a vibrant, sectioned outfit standing behind a striped table with various objects, a fair-skinned, blonde-haired middle-aged male figure in a multicolored geometric costume with a staff and bundle accompanied by a light blue animal on a ground with sparse foliage, a skeletal figure of Death wielding a reddish-orange scythe amidst dark foliage with dismembered heads, and a light skin tone man hanging upside down by his ankle from a stylized branch. The golden lion, depicted in a reflective, textured material, sits in profile against a dark backdrop, its voluminous mane and muscular body detailed, with parts dissolving into sparkling golden particles. A brightly colored, cartoonish-style illustration presents a fair-skinned young adult male with curly blonde hair beneath a red, yellow, and green striped wide-brimmed hat; he wears a blue and red sectioned garment with striped cuffs and green and blue vertically striped leggings with pointy yellow shoes, standing behind a yellow and brown diagonally striped rectangular table holding a blue wand, surrounded by small red objects, a yellow cylinder, a red cup, tan geometric shapes, a beige pouch, and curved beige-handled, silver-bladed tools. Another full-body illustration portrays a fair-skinned, blonde-haired middle-aged man with a beard and mustache, wearing a multicolored costume with stripes and geometric patterns and a pointed hat with bells, carrying a staff and a bundle over his shoulder, with a light blue animal near his feet on yellowish-brown foliage. The XIII Death card displays a golden, reflective skeletal figure holding a reddish-orange scythe, with red details at the joints, amidst dark foliage where golden, reflective dismembered hands and two heads (one young with light blonde curly hair, the other older with a golden crown) are visible. A tarot card shows a light skin tone man hanging upside down by his right ankle from a thick horizontal branch supported by stylized yellow trunks with red leaf-like shapes and green grass-like forms at their base; he wears a yellow and red vest, a light blue and white striped shirt, bright blue pants, and red shoes.
